node.title: THE ENGINE: Khot-Minzer-Safra Johnson-graph structure theorem (import)
node.statement: KMS/DKKMS (proved, 2018-19; the 2-to-2 games engine): non-expanding small sets in Johnson graphs correlate with JUNTAS — sets determined by membership of a bounded core of coordinates. Import note + bridge-ledger row + convention matching (their J(n,j), our exchange graph — same object). The XR inverse's stage-2 engine, now NAMED and off-the-shelf.
node.notes: the tightest literature fit in the program: Johnson graphs are literally KMS's domain; j/n ~ 0.4-0.5 within their regime
